price_policy.exact_identity_join: exact manufacturer part + exact manufacturer + verified supplier part C-code; no CAD carrier substitution

price_policy.full_total_null_rule: any current SKU without an exact verified current quote or with unresolved required identity/quantity makes the complete scenario total null; verified subtotal remains labeled partial
price_policy.minimum_cash_rule: combine same exact SKU across all modules in a scenario before selecting the price tier at the required demand quantity rounded to stated MOQ/order multiple; only move to the next published tier if no tier covers that lot, never borrow a bulk tier for a small order; if MOQ/order multiple missing, report the assumption and leave a fully constrained cash total null
price_policy.stock_rule: zero_snapshot/unknown/out_of_stock inventory is review-needed, not confirmed shortage; only positive known quantity with in_stock or in_stock_snapshot below the chosen lot is counted as stock_shortage
price_policy.scope_rule: scope quantities are carried from each original source demand before identical SKUs are merged; costs are apportioned by those recorded quantities, not by the merged SKU's scope set
